about: Held out: labelled on 2026-10-25 after the matcher's rules were frozen, from memory of the works and of common online wordings, and scored once (scripts/eval-discourse.mjs --heldout). Not used to tune anything.

cases.q: Very little is needed to make a happy life.
Loss is nothing else but change.
The universe is change; our life is what our thoughts make it.
That which is not good for the swarm, neither is it good for the bee.
The hour of departure has arrived, and we go our ways, I to die, and you to live.
I neither know nor think that I know.
Insanity in individuals is something rare, but in groups, parties, nations and epochs it is the rule.
Wealth is like sea-water; the more we drink, the thirstier we become.
Twice two makes four is not life, gentlemen, but is the beginning of death.
That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
To live is the rarest thing in the world. Most people exist, that is all.
The mind is everything. What you think you become.
Pain and suffering are always inevitable for a large intelligence and a deep heart.
Whoever fights monsters must take care that he does not become one in the process of fighting.
